title: Explicit singleton cone-to-dual term isomorphisms
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and a a global section of the unit module. Use the principal negative mapping cones of [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers] and the strict dual singleton diagram of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. Define the degreewise isomorphisms c_m^q between their terms as follows. In degrees 0 and -1, project the cone biproduct to its unique nonzero summand and identify it with R. On the dual side remove the positive diagram's right tensor unit, project Hom into R[0] to source degree -q using the proved projection isomorphism of [lem-sfb-ringed-site-bounded-dual-components], identify the positive double term with R, and evaluate at one. Compose the cone identification with the inverse dual identification. In other degrees both sides are zero: define c_m^q to be their unique isomorphism. Every map and inverse is constructed from these actual projections and existing isomorphisms; no arbitrary witness of a mere existence assertion selects data. The auxiliary APIs record the two cone projections, the dual projection, and vanishing off the supported degrees.
